name: Airtable
prompt: Build a spreadsheet-database hybrid with: create tables with custom columns (text, number, date, select, checkbox), add/edit/delete rows inline, sort and filter columns, switch between grid and kanban view (group by select column), and CSV import/export. SQLite backend with dynamic schema per table. Clean, Airtable-inspired UI.
notes: NocoDB and Baserow prove this is vibecodable. The formula engine and automations are where Airtable earns its price.
